dct_description_sm: Water Quality Data from monthly grab samples collected at 47 sites across nine watersheds in Toronto and Region Conservation Authority’s (TRCA) jurisdiction. Samples are collected monthly following the Provincial Water Quality Monitoring Network (PWQMN) protocol and are analyzed at various private and partner laboratories. Parameters include nutrients, general chemistry, and selected metals.
dct_title_s: TRCA Regional Watershed Monitoring Program (RWMP) - Water Quality Data
